record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.context_brief: Rationality of very general Gushel-Mukai fourfolds
record.original_question: Is a very general Gushel-Mukai fourfold irrational, or could a very general Gushel-Mukai fourfold be rational?

evidence.quote: it is unknown whether the very general one is irrational

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A smooth complex Gushel–Mukai (GM) fourfold is a smooth four-dimensional projective variety $X \subset \mathbb{P}^8$ obtained as the transverse intersection of the cone (with vertex a point) over the Grassmannian $\mathrm{Gr}(2,5) \subset \mathbb{P}^9$ in its Plücker embedding with a linear subspace of codimension 2 and a quadric hypersurface; equivalently, a smooth Fano fourfold of Picard rank 1, index 2, and degree 10 whose anticanonical embedding is contained in $\mathrm{Gr}(2,5)$ (ordinary type) or its cone (special type). Such varieties form an irreducible coarse moduli space of dimension 24.

A complex projective variety is called rational if it is birational to projective space, and irrational otherwise. Some rational GM fourfolds are known to exist (forming proper subvarieties of moduli).

Problem: Determine whether a very general Gushel–Mukai fourfold (i.e., one corresponding to a point in the complement of a countable union of proper Zariski-closed subsets of the moduli space) is irrational, or whether instead a very general Gushel–Mukai fourfold can be rational.
artifact.status_search_result: Historically the irrationality of the very general Gushel–Mukai fourfold was a well-known open question, with several rational examples known but no irrational ones. A 2026 preprint computes the small quantum cohomology of GM fourfolds and, combined with prior obstruction methods, claims to deduce that the very general GM fourfold is not rational. As this is a very recent preprint that has not yet been independently verified or published, the status is best described as partially solved / very recently announced rather than firmly established.

status_evidence.title: Quantum cohomology and irrationality of Gushel-Mukai fourfolds
status_evidence.snippet: We compute the small quantum cohomology of Gushel-Mukai fourfolds. Following [13], our computations imply that the very general ones are not rational.
status_evidence.claim: A 2026 preprint claims to prove irrationality of very general Gushel–Mukai fourfolds via quantum cohomology computations.

status_evidence.title: New examples of rational Gushel-Mukai fourfolds
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions of rational GM fourfolds providing evidence for the analog of Kuznetsov's conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Several rational examples of GM fourfolds are known, forming proper loci in moduli.

status_evidence.title: Degenerations of Gushel–Mukai fourfolds, with a view towards irrationality proofs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses approaches toward irrationality proofs for GM fourfolds.
status_evidence.claim: As of 2018 no GM fourfold was known to be irrational, motivating degeneration approaches.
